comparison.float_policy: abs(go - ort) <= atol + rtol * abs(ort); NaNs match; infinity signs match; signed zero ignored

timing_settings.scope: Session.Run / session.run with owned outputs; no build, process startup, model loading, input encoding or output serialization; runtimes measured sequentially

validation.additional_case_generation: random.Random(20261109); upstream, zeros, ones, 64 uniform[0,1], 64 uniform[-10,10]

notes: Profiling disabled throughout benchmark repetitions and comparisons.
Workspace go 1.26.1 matches both modules and baseline DefaultGODEBUG; toolchain go1.27.2.

An earlier end-to-end sweep used workspace go 1.27.2 and different DefaultGODEBUG. It was retained locally in pre-workspace-alignment; all reported end-to-end repetitions were rebuilt/rerun with aligned defaults.
Kernel baseline uses an overlay restoring only conv2d.go, byte-identical to the published v0.9.0 source; both kernel binaries include identical benchmark/tests.
Full standard comparison reports with per-call latencies and temporary scripts are retained in the temporary_directory.
